principles: Every image or screenshot embedded in a report must trace back to an immutable artifact entry in runs/<run_id>/artifacts_index.json with a verified SHA256 digest.
Never fabricate GUI menu clicks or dialog screenshots when the step was executed via headless API/batch (envipyengine, matlab -batch, arcpy, or pure Python).
Every classification map figure must explicitly bind its class_mapping_manifest and legend (including 0=Unclassified when present) so colors and class labels never drift across software.
Comparison figures (e.g., Raw vs Majority vs Clump vs Sieve) must bind each subplot/panel to its exact branch_id and artifact_id to prevent panel/caption transposition.

required_screenshot_categories.title: 原始多光谱合成图与样本空间分布图
caption_rules: Must state the exact RGB band mapping (e.g., TM4/TM3/TM2 false color or TM3/TM2/TM1 true color).
When has_crs is false, axis/scale labels must use pixel coordinates (column, row) and never claim geographic lat/lon or metric scale bars.

required_screenshot_categories.title: 光谱指数、PCA 主成分与 K-T 变换分量图
caption_rules: For K-T transform on Landsat 5 TM, the 3rd panel must be labeled 'Third (Wetness-related)' rather than calibrated absolute wetness.
For PCA, caption must state fit_domain ('full_image_unsupervised' or 'train_split_only') and cumulative variance percentages.

required_screenshot_categories.title: 非监督与监督分类专题图
caption_rules: Legend must list every semantic class name alongside its native integer code and color.
If algorithm is Parallelepiped or thresholded ML or Sieve, 0=Unclassified must appear in the legend with its pixel share.
If ISODATA degenerated_to_kmeans is true, caption must disclose that 0 splits and 0 merges occurred.

required_screenshot_categories.title: 分类后处理多分支对比图与局部放大图（含水体保持对比）
caption_rules: Each panel must map 1-to-1 to branch_id (e.g., raw_ml, majority_3x3, clump_3x3, sieve_2px, clump_then_sieve).
Must highlight linear water body retention/erosion when Majority or Clump causes water pixel loss exceeding threshold.

allowed_phrases: 通过 envipyengine 无头任务接口执行
通过 matlab -batch 批处理脚本执行
通过 ArcGIS Pro arcpy 脚本执行
基于方法包确定性算子计算并导出专题渲染图
forbidden_phrases: 在弹出的对话框中勾选
在 Toolbox 界面双击打开
